sloka: वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः ।ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः ।। ७.१०७.१० ॥
transliteration: vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇīṁ prakṛtīrgatāḥ ।jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṁ kāryaṁ mā caiṣāṁ vipriyaṁ kṛthāḥ ।। 7.107.10 ॥

translations.english: Vasishtha said, "Dear Rama, behold these subjects fallen to the ground; understanding their desire, do not cause them any displeasure."
